Higher than planned catastrophe activity on the Property Direct and Facultative book

data.standardized_narrative: Gross claims reserves were broadly unchanged on a gross basis at year end. The gross claims development table shows no material movement on prior underwriting years; on a net basis the syndicate reported a small adverse prior-year development of GBP 1.5m. The slight net adverse movement was driven by higher-than-expected catastrophe activity on the Property Direct and Facultative book (Hurricane Dorian, Storm Imelda), adverse experience and reserve strengthening in the Casualty Treaty class, and reduced/low reinsurance recoveries (notably on North American specialty programmes).
raw_causal_phrases: Claims incurred during the year, net of reinsurance, include adverse prior year development of GBP 1.5m (2018: GBP 11.5m positive development).

Claims incurred in 2019 were impacted by higher than planned catastrophe activity on the Property Direct and Facultative book (Hurricane Dorian, Storm Imelda) as well as adverse experience and also reserve strengthening of the Casualty Treaty class.

The net loss ratio was additionally impacted by a reduction in expected reinsurance recoveries for North American Specialty Programs and relatively low reinsurance recoveries on gross claims incurred in the year.

data.data_quality_notes: Gross prior-year development computed from the gross claims development triangle (gross triangle shows effectively no movement for underwriting years <=2017). A reconciliation row 'Claims incurred in prior underwriting years' appears in the claims reconciliation (gross 66,328) but that row pertains to gross claims incurred presented in the movements table and was not used as the 'movement in prior year's provision' primary source.
